accessMethod: Individually opened and read in Chrome; complete rendered directory and all sections read. Structured names, titles and profile links captured from visible roster cards; no personal contacts saved.
population: All 89 cards on the Faculty and Staff page: 41 core, 19 graduate-field, 12 emeriti, 6 research/teaching professionals, 7 staff and 4 affiliated staff. Current source date only; no worldwide or historical census.
selectionBasis: Oldest roster retrieval date 2026-10-16; preserve public pages order to break date ties. First named-qualifying Cornell roster in that order without prior roster people is the old ORIE faculty.cfm URL (404, zero listed). Earlier Cornell business blank page requires separate cross-area review; Cornell Tech broad page already has 56 observations. ORIE selected as first failed named school-specific roster at this frontier, not a claim of globally oldest unreviewed unit.
